  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Alvarado made comments regarding a regional job fair hiring opportunity from
Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Development Board.

Mayor Roa encouraged the residents to attend the job fair.

Councilmember Maravilla resigned from the City of Hawaiian Gardens as a Councilmember.

All City Councilmembers thanked Councilmember Maravilla for all her hard work and dedication to the
City.
